Programs

IIT Palakkad conducts undergraduate academic program of B. Tech, postgraduate course programs of M. Tech and M.Sc. and research programs leading to M.S and Ph.D. in various disciplines.

Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.)

B.Tech with Minor List

Regulations 2022 onwards

Curriculum Highlights

Institute Core Courses

  • Civil Engineering (Curriculum 2022 Onwards)
  • Computer Science and Engineering (Curriculum 2022 Onwards)
  • Data Science and Engineering (Curriculum 2022 Onwards)
  • Electrical Engineering (Curriculum 2022 Onwards)
  • Mechanical Engineering (Curriculum 2022 Onwards)
  • Materials Engineering (Curriculum 2026 Onwards)

 

Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.)

Regulations 2017-2021

Amendment

  • Civil Engineering (Curriculum 2018, 2019, 2020 & 2021)
  • Computer Science and Engineering (Curriculum 2018, 2019, 2020 & 2021)
  • Electrical Engineering (Curriculum 2018, 2019, 2020 & 2021)
  • Mechanical Engineering (Curriculum 2018, 2019, 2020 & 2021)

 

Master of Science (M.Sc)

  • Chemistry (Curriculum 2020, 2024 , 2025)
  • Physics (Curriculum 2020, 2024)
  • Mathematics (Curriculum 2020, 2024)

Regulations 2019-2023

Regulations 2024 onwards

Master of Technology (M.Tech)

  • Geotechnical Engineering  (Curriculum 2020, 2024)
  • Manufacturing and Materials Engineering (Curriculum 2020, 2024)
  • Computing and Mathematics (Curriculum 2020, 2024)
  • Data Science (Curriculum 2020, 2024)
  • Power Electronics and Power Systems (Curriculum 2020, 2024)
  • System-on-Chip Design  (Curriculum 2020, 2024)
  • Design & Automation (Curriculum 2025 onwards) 
  • Thermofluids Engineering (Curriculum 2025 onwards)
  • Structural Engineering (Curriculum 2025 onwards)
  • Water Resources Engineering (Curriculum 2025 onwards)

Regulations 2019-2023

Regulations 2024 onwards
